name: Procurement Overview

native.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pro_purchase_requests WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT date_trunc('month', payment_date) as month, SUM(total_amount) as spend FROM pro_purchase_orders WHERE status = 'DELIVERED' AND payment_status = 'PAID' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

SELECT v.name, SUM(po.total_amount) as total_spend FROM pro_purchase_orders po JOIN pro_vendors v ON v.id = po.vendor_id WHERE po.status = 'DELIVERED' AND po.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY v.name ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 10
